SELECT reason,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_total_events,
  SUM(quantity_delta) AS net_quantity_delta,
  SUM(ABS(quantity_delta)) AS total_abs_quantity_delta,
  ROUND(AVG(ABS(quantity_delta)), 2) AS avg_abs_quantity_delta
FROM stock_adjustments
WHERE created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND ABS(quantity_delta) = 1
GROUP BY reason
ORDER BY event_count DESC, reason ASC
LIMIT 50
note: "Routine, single-unit, year-round" entries were interpreted as rows where ABS(quantity_delta)=1 (the one-unit-at-a-time stream that would feed cycle_count movements); other adjustment sizes (bulk corrections, etc.) are excluded. Grouped by the exact reason string with no bucketing, as requested; if the result hits the 50-row cap the true distinct-reason count is higher and worth a follow-up.
